title.value: Hire a Fiverr freelancer and build an ads sheet by computer use

introduction.value: The author used Claude Dispatch with computer use to post a Fiverr job and message top candidates, build a Google Sheet of ads on a topic, and schedule recurring tasks.

method.value: Ruben Hassid paired the Claude desktop app (Mac, paid personal plan) with Dispatch on his phone, with computer use and browser use turned on. He texted a prompt telling Claude to post a Fiverr job, message the 10 best freelancers and follow up on DMs. A second prompt had it search the Meta Ads Library and put ad links into a Google Sheet. He then set up a scheduled task.

outcome.value: Fiverr produced 4 offers within a few hours while he was out. The Meta Ads sheet worked, though his own test asked for only 10 ads, not 50. Dispatch asked him some questions along the way.

notes.value: The computer must stay on and awake. Dispatch sometimes asks permission, so say explicitly that it should proceed without asking. He blocked 1Password from computer access.

Hire a Fiverr freelancer and build an ads sheet by computer use
The author used Claude Dispatch with computer use to post a Fiverr job and message top candidates, build a Google Sheet of ads on a topic, and schedule recurring tasks.
Done with
CU
Claude computer use
CL
Claude
What they did
Ruben Hassid paired the Claude desktop app (Mac, paid personal plan) with Dispatch on his phone, with computer use and browser use turned on. He texted a prompt telling Claude to post a Fiverr job, message the 10 best freelancers and follow up on DMs. A second prompt had it search the Meta Ads Library and put ad links into a Google Sheet. He then set up a scheduled task.
How it went
Fiverr produced 4 offers within a few hours while he was out. The Meta Ads sheet worked, though his own test asked for only 10 ads, not 50. Dispatch asked him some questions along the way.
Worth knowing
The computer must stay on and awake. Dispatch sometimes asks permission, so say explicitly that it should proceed without asking. He blocked 1Password from computer access.
Try it yourself
with
Claude computer use
Copy prompt
Using my desktop, post a job on Fiverr for [type of freelancer, e.g. ad copywriter] with this brief: [short description and budget]. Then shortlist the top [3] candidates and draft a message to each, and build a Google Sheet of [number] example ads about [topic] with columns for [e.g. headline, platform, link]. Pause and show me the job post and each message before you publish or send anything, and stop once the sheet is filled and the drafts are ready for my approval.
Original source: https://ruben.substack.com/p/claude-computer
